content: To quantify the improvement provided by Doc2Vec in our framework, we constructed a MST-kNN graph following the same steps but starting with TF-iDF vectors for each document. We then ran MS on this TF-iDF similarity graph, and compared the results to those obtained from the Doc2Vec similarity graph. Figure 7 shows that the Doc2Vec version outperforms the BoW version across all resolutions in terms of both $NMI$ and $\widehat{PMI}$ scores.
